answer: Sealed lottery admission gate. Each round an agent derives a seed from a verifiable random function over the prior block hash, so no one can precompute which slot an identity will draw before committing. An identity must submit a copper-signed enrollment ticket blind, then reveal after the seed locks; the wharf admits only tickets whose reveal matches the sealed commitment or the bond is slashed. Colluding sybils must fund a fresh opal deposit per identity, and because losing tickets forfeit that deposit at random, mass enrollment costs scale linearly with expected rejected slots.
